plans.note: Liability architecture sits in Para 21 (p0240 liability limited to express provisions, several and not joint; p0242 exclusion of loss of traffic/business/anticipated savings and indirect or consequential loss) plus the PG non-liability and warranty disclaimer at p0126-p0127. No monetary aggregate cap and no express carve-outs; worker should assess mutuality (it is reciprocal, consortium-style) and whether the absence of a cap and carve-outs is a material fallback failure.

Mutual party-to-party indemnity at 21.2 (p0241) for owner-related third-party claims, plus the claims-settlement/cost-sharing machinery in Para 32 (p0275-p0280). No IP-infringement indemnity or vendor-misconduct indemnity in our favour; the structure is reciprocal consortium sharing rather than one-way vendor indemnity — worker to assess against the rule.

No restriction on the businesses we may operate or systems we may build/buy located. Only incidental 'competent jurisdiction/tribunal' hits (p0272, p0275) and express freedom-from-restriction language at p0206 and p0208, which favours us. Treat as missing/no restriction; confirm no covenant hides in Paras 12-17.

No purchasing exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation found. The only 'exclusive' hit is the sole-and-exclusive-remedy language in the dispute clause (p0262), which belongs to GOVLAW; p0206/p0208 confirm we may resell/IRU capacity without restriction. Likely no responsive obligation.

Direction check: p0220 requires transiting facilities on terms 'no less favorable' than those granted to other Carriers, and p0224-p0225 require reasonable, non-discriminatory access — both run in our favour as a capacity owner/accessing party. Do not flag unless a worker finds a reciprocal obligation requiring us to give best terms.

No non-solicitation, no-hire or employee-restraint language located across multiple seed sets (solicit, employ, hire, personnel, staff, recruit). Expect missing; no redline needed for a customer-side restraint that does not exist.

Exit rights are in Para 18: 18.1 (p0228) permits a Party to terminate its participation at the end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter; 18.2 (p0229) unanimous termination during the Initial Period; 18.3 (p0230) decommissioning vote. Note the penalty aspect at p0233 (no credit for capital costs on termination) and the continuing-obligation tail at p0280 — worker to assess whether there is any mid-term convenience exit for us and whether counterparties can walk away.

Term is a 25-year Initial Period from the RFS Date, terminable thereafter by agreement of the Parties (p0228), with post-Initial-Period decommissioning at p0230-p0231. No auto-renewal or non-renewal notice window and no renewal pricing mechanic; worker to note the continuation-by-agreement structure rather than treating it as an auto-renewal deviation.

Dispute resolution is Para 27 (p0262): matters go to the Management Committee, which resolves or determines the method (such as arbitration); expressly the 'sole and exclusive remedy', with p0263 restricting evidentiary use. No governing-law or venue designation found (p0239 and p0260 only reference the law of the place of arbitration/litigation and general compliance). Worker to assess the absent governing law and the committee/arbitration route against the accepted-forum list.

Primary clause is Para 22.1 (p0246), which cross-refers to Para 12 and is the assignment consent gate; Para 30 (p0269) binds successors and permitted assigns, and p0261 ratifies decisions as binding on successors/assigns. Capacity transfer/IRU rights at p0189, p0206-p0210 are related but distinct. Worker to check affiliate/successor assignment freedom and any change-of-control exit for other Parties.

Ownership regime is Para 4 (p0107 provision/construction/ownership; p0119 Wet Segment ownership per Schedule B) and Para 12 (p0187 capacity on an ownership basis; p0210/p0214 transfers of ownership), with liquidation of assets at p0234 and the IRU definition (no ownership conveyed) at p0054. Data/information is governed by the Para 31 confidentiality regime (p0270-p0273) rather than a customer-data clause — direction check: nothing assigns our IP or data to counterparties.

The grant analogue is the Terminal Station Right of Use in Para 11 (p0179 grant; p0182 no additional charges; p0183 renunciation/substitution; p0184 grant to IRU purchasers) plus the IRU concept (p0054) and onward-use rights at p0206-p0208. Worker to check duration (life of system, not revocable at will) and whether affiliates/other Carriers are covered.

Para 9 is the books/records and review regime (p0160-p0165 record-keeping and five-year retention; p0163 and p0167 review/audit rights available to any Party, including us), with inspection of operations at p0177 (each Party at its own expense) and construction inspection access at p0123. Rights appear reciprocal and largely in our favour; worker to check notice, frequency and cost allocation for audits of us.

Direction check on amounts payable by us: default and capacity reclamation without payment or credit (p0255-p0256), extended payment charges on late amounts (p0154, p0155, p0157) and forfeiture of capital-cost credit on termination (p0233). No conventional liquidated damages; worker to assess whether the forfeiture/reclamation mechanics operate as a penalty against us.

Only warranty language is the disclaimer at 4.9-4.10 (p0126: PG makes no representations or warranties as to Supplier performance, Wet Segment performance/reliability, or integration; p0127: nothing to be construed as a warranty or guarantee). No performance warranty period or remedy runs to us — strong candidate for a deviation, subject to the worker confirming that Supply Contract warranties are passed through elsewhere.

Insurance appears only as a cost concept: p0133 includes insurance or an allowance in lieu within costs, and 5.3 (p0139) makes insurance permissive ('may at its own expense insure against risks'; joint insurance costs become Capital Costs). No mandated coverage types, limits, additional-insured or certificate obligations — worker to assess as effectively missing.

No take-or-pay or volume minimum as such; the analogue is the mandatory cost-allocation/billing obligation in Para 7 (p0146 allocation of Capital Costs; p0141-p0142 O&M cost components; p0153 rate reference) tied to Investment Shares/MIU (p0055, Schedule B at p0040). Worker to assess whether the fixed share obligation plus the no-credit exit (p0233) amounts to take-or-pay without an exit.

End-of-term mechanics are in Para 18: schedule amendment on withdrawal (p0232), realization/liquidation and distribution of assets on decommissioning (p0234-p0235), plus survival of accrued obligations at p0280 and the record-retention period at p0161 / confidentiality tail at p0274. No data return or migration/transition-assistance obligation; worker to assess whether the asset-realization provisions satisfy the rule or it is effectively missing.
